en: The postcard depicts a scenic view of a European city, featuring a river bordered by a promenade, historical buildings, a distinctive tower with a green onion dome, and a hill topped with a landmark clock tower. The style appears to be an illustrated or hand-tinted photograph. There are several people dressed in early 20th-century attire along the riverbank. A visible sign reads 'Schwarzbäck Konditorei'.
